title: Dukessa

services.name: Venue Tour
services.desc: Delicious and fresh food comes straight out of our full-service, on-site commercial kitchen prepared by our experienced and talented culinary team. Led by our James Beard Semi-finalist Executive Chef, Ross Coleman, you and your guests will experience customized dishes that are beautifully presented and are freshly prepared “straight out of the oven”. Serving innovative, flavorful dishes in many different cuisines, is our specialty! Our award-winning culinary can’t wait to serve you! As a local, women owned business, we are proud to serve the Houston community in a socially conscious way. Dukessa is thrilled to have partnered with Second Servings (a non-profit organization) to beat hunger

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: A turnkey corporate event venue, Dukessa has offers a full-service experience for all types of corporate events in Houston including Holiday / Christmas Parties, Conferences, Monthly Breakfast or Lunch Meetings, Organization Events, Product Launches, Networking Socials, Awards Banquets, or Retirement Parties for 35 to 250 guests (seated) or up to 300 guests (corporate reception). ​ Centrally located right in the heart of Houston, a mile from The Galleria, Dukessa event spaces offers a neutral space to host both indoor and outdoor corporate events. A large, open ballroom with separate pre-function areas combined with a nicely-lit private outdoor patio makes Dukessa a perfect to host all
